items.statement: Bounded inference about discriminate metal-induced electronic changes from ligand deformation in Cd/Co/Ni DQCS complexes, using free and frozen ligand controls and properly treated open-shell response.. All required contrasts and one actual robustness check govern the conclusion; the source claim is not the required answer.
